'''Sq'irk trees''' are a species of tree that are found in the [[Sorceress's Garden]] minigame. They stand at the end of each maze and yield a certain type of [[sq'irk]] fruit. The type of sq'irk that it yields depends on which maze the player is in. The types of sq'irk trees are winter, spring, autumn, and summer. Picking a sq'irk will give a player 30 to 60 [[Farming]] experience, depending on the tree picked. When a sq'irk is picked off the tree, the player will magically be teleported outside of the maze.

These trees cannot be chopped down.
